text.body:
bhaṭṭabhāskarādhvarīndraviracitaḥ sāmavedārṣeyadīpaḥ vedasāmnāmṛṣicchandraḥ prakārā(a)tha devatāḥ| ārṣeyādyanusāreṇa bhūtyai bhāskarayajvanām||1|| kāśyapānvayasaṃbhūtabhāskārābhidhayajvanā| anekaṛṣiddṛṣṭānāṃ bhaprakīrtyate||2|| pratihārārṣeyakalpasūtraddṛṣṭaśrutāvapi| prākṛtīnāmṛcāṃ sāmnāmṛṣiśchando'tha devatā||3|| idantāpratyayo nāma iyattā ca vicāryate| ārṣeyabharata sāmānusārataḥ||4|| ṛṣīṇāṃ nāmagotropadhāraṇam| svargyaṃ yaśasyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ putryaṃ paśavyaṃ brahmavarcasyaṃ smārtamāyuṣyam| iti (ādinā)| ya idamupadhārayate ekaikasyarṣerdivyaṃ varṣasahasramatithirbhavati| abhinanditaḥ pratinandito mānitaḥ pūjitaḥ tataḥ svādhyāyaphalamupajīvati ityādinā, yo ha vā aviditārṣeyacchandodaivatabrāhmaṇena mantreṇa yājayati vādhyāpayati vā sthāṇuṃ varcchati gartaṃ vā padyati pravā mīyate pāpīyān bhavati | yātayāmānyasya chandāṃsi bhavanti| atha yo mantre mantre veda sarvamāyureti| śreyān bhavati| ayātayāmānyasya chandāṃsi bhavanti| tasmādetāni mantre mantre vidyāt | ṛṣīṇāṃ sasthāno bhavati| (sasthāno bhavati) brahmaṇaḥ| svarge loke mahīyate| smarannājayate punaḥ| ya evaṃ veda| tānyārṣeyāṇi yo'dhīte brahmaṇaḥ paṅktipāvano bhavati iti(ādinā ca )anvayavtirekābhyām ṛṣyāderavaśyavedyatvapratipādanāt ṛksāmayoḥ krameṇa tāḥ pratipādyante| atra tāvannidānakāreṇa ---sāmnāṃ chando devatā ca asti| nāstīti gautamaḥ | yacchandasyāmṛci gīyate tadasya chandaḥ| yadyevatyāyāṃ sāsya devatā| iti prativāditam||1|| ṛṣayastu ṛksāmayorbhidyante | chandodaivatayorna bhedaḥ||2|| āgneyamaindraṃ pāvamānamiti trīṇi parvāṇi| āgneyasāmnām agnirdevatetyutsargaḥ| aindrāṇāmindraḥ| pāvamānānāṃ somaḥ| kvacid viśeṣastatra tatra vakṣyate||3|| atha āgneyaṃ parva chandāṃsi(....agna āyāhi iti ādita--) stryanuvākānāṃ gāyatrī chandaḥ| caturthaprabhṛtīnāṃ trayaṇāmanuvākānāṃ bṛhatī chandaḥ| ājuhoteti saptasya jagatī chandaḥ| abodhyagririti(aṣṭamasya)triṣṭup chandaḥ | agna ojiṣṭheti navamadaśamayoranuṣṭup chandaḥ| purutvā detyekādaśasya uṣṇik chandaḥ| pramaṃhiṣṭhīyeti dvādaśasya kakup chandaḥ||1|| ityāgneyaṃ parva|| atha aindraṃ parva tadvo gāyetyādito dvādaśānuvākānāṃ gāyatrī chandaḥ| abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ ityaṣṭānuvākānāṃ bṛhatī chandaḥ| asāvi devaṃ goṛjīvamandha iti trayāṇāṃ triṣṭup chandaḥ| gāyanti tveti trayāṇām anuvākānām anuṣṭup chandaḥ| viśvāḥ pṛtanetyatijagatī chandaḥ| śratte dadhāmītyuttarā jagatyaḥ| indra suteṣvityanuvā(kau dvāvuṣṇihau ) abhrātṛvya ityanuvākaḥ kakubhaḥ|svādoritthetyanuvākadvayaṃ pāṅktam| pari pra dhanvetyanuvākatrayaṃ dvipadarcam| trikadrukeṣviti anuvāko'ticchandaskaḥ||1|| ||iti aindraṃ parva|| atha pāvamānaṃ parva uccā te jātam ityanuvākacatuṣṭayaṃ gāyatrī chandaḥ| punānaḥ soma dhārayeti pañcamasya bṛhatī| pra tu draveti anuvākadvayasya triṣṭup | purojitīti anuvākasya anuṣṭup | abhi priyāṇīti jagatī| indramacchetyasya uṣṇik | pavasva madhumattama ityasya kakup||1|| ||iti pāvamānaṃ parva|| indra jyeṣṭhamityāraṇyānuvākānāṃ pañcānāṃ na(nā)chandaskatvaṃ nānādevatyaṃ ca | ṛṣiprakaraṇe tattacchandodevatā vakṣyante||
āgneyaṃ parva atha ṛcāṃ sāmnāṃ ca krameṇa ṛṣaya ucyante--- agna ā yāhi ityasyā ṛcaḥ bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ | tatsāmnāṃ prathamasya parkasya gautamaḥ| dvitīyasya barhiṣyasya kaśyapaḥ | tṛtīyasya parkasya gautamaḥ| ||1|| tvamagne yajñānām ityasya bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ| sāmnaḥ sauparṇaḥ| ||2|| agniṃ dūtamityasyā ṛco medhātithiḥ ṛṣiḥ |sāmno bṛhadbhāradvājasya bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ|||3|| agnirvṛtrāṇi ityasya bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ| tatsāmnāṃ śrautarṣāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ śrutarṣiḥ| ||4|| preṣṭhaṃ va ityṛcaḥ uśanāḥ | sāmnāṃ prathamatṛtīyayorauśanayoḥ uśanāḥ| madhyamasya śairīṣasya śirīṣaḥ||||5|| tvaṃ no agne mahobhiḥ ityasya ṛṣiḥ sudītiḥ| sāmnoḥ sāṃvargavārtraghnayorindraḥ| ||6|| ehyūṣu iti ṛco bharadvājaḥ | tatsāmnoḥ sākamaśvayoḥ śaunaḥśepaḥ sākamaśva ṛṣiḥ| |7|| ā te vatsa ityṛco vatsa ṛṣiḥ| tatsāmnośca vātsayorvatsa eva kāṇvaḥ| ||8|| tvāmagre puṣkarāt ityṛcaḥ bharadvājaḥ| tatsāmna āgneyasya agni ṛṣiḥ ||9|| agre vivasvadā bhara ityṛco vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ | tatsāmno vādhrayaśvasya vaghyaśvaḥ anūpa ṛṣiḥ||||10|| ityāgneye prathamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ namaste agna ojase ityasya viśvarupa āṅigarasa ṛṣiḥ| tatsāmnaḥ sāṃvargasya agniḥ ||11|| dūtaṃ vaḥ ityṛco vāmadevaḥ | sāmno vaiśvamanasasya viśvamanāḥ||||12|| upa tvā jāmayaḥ ityṛco bhārgavaḥ| tatsāmnām (mnoḥ?) agniḥ śvābhaśnauṣṭīyayoḥ | ||13)|| upa tvāgre ityṛco vaiśvāmitro madhucchandāḥ| tatsāmno vaiśvāmitrasya viśvāmitraḥ| ||14) jarābodha ityṛcaḥ śunaḥ śepaḥ| tatsāmnorjarābodhīyayoḥ agni ṛṣiḥ||15|| prati tyaṃ cārumityṛcaḥ śunaḥśepaḥ | sāmnāṃ vārayantīyānāṃ bhṛguḥ śunaḥ śepo vā||||16) aśvaṃ na tvā ityṛcaḥ śunaḥśepaḥ| sāmnāṃ vārayantīyānāṃ bhṛguḥśunaḥ śepo vā || ||17|| aurvabhṛguvat ityṛcaḥ prayoga ṛṣiḥ | tatsāmnorvaidhārayayoḥ aurvo vaidhārayaḥ|| ||18|| agnimindhāna ityṛcaḥ prayoga ṛṣiḥ| tatsāmnaḥ hyatriḥ||||19|| ādit pratnasya ityṛcaḥ kāṇvo vatsaḥ | tatsāmnaḥ nidhanakāmasya prajāpatiḥ||||20|| ||ityāgneye dvitīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ|| tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ agniṃ vo vṛdhante ityṛcaḥ prayogaḥ | tatsāmāni saindhukṣitāni| sindhukṣiddṛṣiḥ trayāṇām||||21|| agnistigmena ityṛco bharadvājaḥ | tatsāmnoragniḥ| ihavadvāmadevyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ | (tasya)vāmadevaḥ||22|| agne mṛḍa ityṛco vāmadevaḥ | tatsāmnoryāmayoḥ yamaḥ||||23|| agne rakṣā ṇaḥ ityṛco bharadvājaḥ| tatsāmno'gniḥ||||24|| agne yuṅkṣva ityṛco bharadvājaḥ| tatsāmno'gniḥ||||25|| ni tvā nakṣya ityṛco vasiṣṭhaḥ| tatsāmnaḥ vaiśvamanasasya viśvamanāḥ||||26|| agnirmūrdhā ityṛco viśvarupaḥ (virupaḥ?) | sāmnaśvāgneyasyāgniḥ||||27|| imamūṣu tvam ityṛcaḥ śunaḥśepaḥ| tatsāmnaḥ somasāmnaḥ somaḥ ||28|| taṃ tvā gopavanaityṛcaḥ ātreyaḥ | tatsāmnaḥ gau(go)ṣavanaḥ|| parivājapati ityṛcaḥ vāmadevaḥ | tatsāmnaḥ sūryasāma (mnaḥ?) ṛṣiḥ sūryaḥ ||||30|| udu ityam ityṛcaḥ meghātithiḥ | tatsāmnaḥ kāvasya kaviḥ||||31|| kavimagnimityṛco meghātithiḥ| tatsāmnaḥ kāvasya kaviḥ||||32|| śaṃ no devīḥ ityṛcaḥ sindhudvīpa ṛṣiḥ | tatsāmnoḥ kāśītayoḥ kāśītaḥ||33|| kasya nūnamityṛcaḥ uśanā ṛṣiḥ | gorāṅgirasasya sāmanī dve| tayorāṅgirasayorgau ṛṣiḥ||||34|| gāyatryāṃ khaṇḍatraye ṛcaḥ|| ityāgneye tṛtīyaḥ khaṇḍaḥ caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || atha bṛhatyṛcaḥ|| yajñāyajñā ityṛcaḥ śaṃyurbārhaspatya ṛṣiḥ| sāmnāṃ caturṇāmādye bharadvājasyaupahane (have?) | tayoḥ bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ | śnauṣṭīgavaṃ tṛtīyam| śnuṣṭīguḥ ṛṣiḥ| yajñāyajñīyaṃ caturtham| tasyāgnirvaiśvānara ṛṣiḥ||||35|| pāhi no agna ityṛco bharga ṛṣiḥ| sāmnāṃ kārtayaśaṃ prathamam| tasya kṛtayaśā ṛṣiḥ| nārmedhaṃ dvitīyam| tasya nṛmedhā aṅgira ṛṣiḥ| kārtaveśaṃ tṛtīyam| tasya kṛtaveṣa ṛṣiḥ||||36|| bṛhadbhiragna ityṛcaḥ śaṃyu ṛṣiḥ | sāmnorbharadvājasya pṛśninorbharadvāja ṛṣiḥ||||37|| tve agne svāhuta ityṛco vasiṣṭhaḥ ṛṣiḥ| sāmna urorāṅgirasasya ururaṅgirāḥ||||38|| agne jaritarviśpatiḥityasyā ṛcaḥ bharga ṛṣiḥ| sāmnoḥ paurumudgayoḥ gautamaḥ purumudga ṛṣiḥ||||39|| agne vivasvaduṣasa ityṛcaḥ praskaṇva ṛṣiḥ| sāmnoḥ māṇḍavayormaṇḍurjamadagnirṛṣiḥ||||40|| tvaṃ naścitra ūtyā ityasyā ṛcaḥ śaṃyu ṛṣiḥ| sāmno gādhasya bharadvājaḥ ṛṣiḥ||||41|| tvamitsaprathā ityṛcaḥ śaṃyu (bharguḥ?) ṛṣiḥ | sāmnorgautamayo gaurtama ṛṣiḥ||||42|| ā no agne vayo vṛdham ityasyā ṛcaḥ śaṃyu (bhargaḥ?)ṛṣiḥ| sāmnaḥ agnerāyuṣaḥ agni ṛṣiḥ|| ||43|| yo viśvā dayate vasu ityṛcaḥ saubhariḥ ṛṣiḥ| sāmnām(caturṇā)mādyayoḥ agnerharasoragniḥ ṛṣiḥ| parayordairghaśravasayoḥ dīrghaśravā ṛṣiḥ||||44|| ||ityāgneye prathame'dhyāye caturthaḥ khaṇḍaḥ|| pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ enā vo agniṃ namasā ityasyā ṛcaḥ vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ | sāmnāṃ caturṇāmādyayorāgneyayoragniṛṣiḥ| parayorgautamasya manādyayorgautama ṛṣiḥ||||45|| śeṣe vaneṣu ityṛco bharga ṛṣiḥ| sāmno de(dai?)varājasya devarāja ṛṣiḥ||||46)|| adarśi gatuvittamaḥityṛcaḥ saubhariḥ ṛṣiḥ| sāmnaḥ kauśikasya gādhī kauśika ṛṣiḥ||||47|| agnirukthe purohitaityṛco manurvaivasvata ṛṣiḥ| sāmnorbārhadukthayorbṛhaduktha ṛṣiḥ||||48|| agnimīḍiṣva ityṛcaḥ suditiḥ (ṛṣiḥ)purumīḍho vā| sāmnaśca paurumīḍhasya purumīḍha ṛṣiḥ| ||49|| śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhiḥ ityasyā ṛcaḥ praskaṇva ṛṣiḥ| sāmnaśca prāskaṇvasya praskaṇva ṛṣiḥ||||50|| pra daivodāso'gniḥityasyā ṛcaḥ saubhariḥ ṛṣiḥ| sāmno daivodāsasya divodāsa ṛṣiḥ|| ||51|| adha jbho adha vā ityṛcaḥ medhātithiḥ(ṛṣiḥ)sāmnaḥ saukratavasya sukratuḥ ṛṣiḥ | iyamaindrī | asyā indro devatā || ||52|| kāyamāno vanā tvam ityṛcaḥ viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ| vaidyuto'gnirdevatā| sāmnoḥ kāṇvayoḥ kaṇva ṛṣiḥ||||53|| ni tvāmagre manurdadheityasyāḥ kaṇva ṛṣiḥ|| sāmnormānavayormanurṛṣiḥ||||54|| || ityāgneye prathame'dhyāye pañcamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ|| ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ devo vo draviṇodā ityṛco vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ | sāmnaḥ draviṇasya agnirṛṣiḥ|| ||55|| praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ ityṛcaḥ kaṇvaḥ (ṛṣiḥ) sāmnaḥ bārhaspatyasya bṛhaspatirṛṣiḥ | brahmaṇaspatirdevatā||||56|| ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ityasyā ṛcaḥ kaṇva ṛṣiḥ| ucchriyamāṇo yūpo devatā| sāmno va(|)siṣṭhasya vīṅkasya vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ|| ||57|| pra yo rāye ninīṣati ityasyā ṛcaḥ vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ | sāmno viṣpardhasāṅgirasasya aṅgirā ṛṣiḥ|| ||58|| pra vo yahvaṃ puruṇām ityasyā ṛcaḥ kaṇva ṛṣiḥ| sāmno aitavārddhiyasya (aita)varddhirṛṣiḥ|| ||59|| ayamagniḥ suvīryasya ityṛcaḥ kātyotka(tkī?)la ṛṣiḥ| sāmno neḍaśca (!)mana ṛṣiḥ || ||60|| tvamagne gṛhapatiḥityṛcaḥ vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ| sāmnāṃ samantānātrayāṇāmādyasya agnirṛṣiḥ| parayorvaruṇaḥ||||61|| sakhāyastvā vavṛmahe ityṛco viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ| sāmno āñjīgo dānava ṛṣiḥ|| ||62|| ityāgneye prathame'dhyāye ṣaṣṭhaḥ khaṇḍaḥ|| ||ityanuvākatrayaṃ bṛhatīcchandaskam|| saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ā juhūtā ityṛk bṛhatīchandaskam(skā?)| vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ| sāmnaḥ śyāvāśvasya śyāvāśva ṛṣiḥ|| ||63|| citra icchiśoḥ ityṛcaḥ tvāṣṭrīhavyaḥ ṛṣiḥ| jagatī chandaḥ| sāmnoḥ ṛtuṣāmnoḥ ṛtava ṛṣiḥ||||64|| idaṃ ta ekam ityṛcaḥ bṛhadakthaḥ ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ|sāmno yāmasya yama ṛṣiḥ| agniryā ||65|| imaṃ stomam ityṛcaḥ kutsa ṛṣiḥ | jagatī chandaḥ| sāmno yajñasāratheḥ kutsa eva ṛṣiḥ|| ||66|| mūrdhānaṃ divo aratimityṛcaḥ bharadvājaḥ ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ| sāmnorvaiśvānarayoḥ agnirvaiśvānara ṛṣiḥ ||67|| vitvadāvo na parvatasya ityṛcaḥ bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ| sāmnorāśvayoraśva ṛṣiḥ||( grā.ge.111-112)||68|| ā vo rājānamadhvarasya ityṛcaḥ vāmadevaḥ(ṛṣiḥ) triṣṭap chandaḥ| rudro devateti kecit | agnirevetyanye | sāmno vāmadevasya vāmadevo rudro vā ṛṣiḥ||||69|| indhe rājā samarya ityṛcaḥ vasiṣṭhaḥ ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ| sāmnorvaiśvajyotiṣayorviśvajyotioḥ ṛṣiḥ|| ||70|| pra ketunā bṛhatā ityṛcaḥ triśirāḥ tvāṣṭraḥ ṛṣiḥ | triṣṭup chandaḥ | sāmnoryāmayoryama ṛṣiḥ||||71|| agniṃ naro ityṛcaḥ vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ| tripadā virāṭ chandaḥ| sāmnoḥ rāśimarāyayoḥ vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ|| ||72|| || ityāgneye prathame'dhyāye saptamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ|| aṣṭamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ abodhyagniḥ ityṛcaḥ budhagaviṣṭhirāvṛṣī| triṣṭup chandaḥ sāmnaḥ śyenasya prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiḥ||||73|| prabhurjayantamityṛcaḥ vatsa ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ| sāmnaḥ śukrasya śukra ṛṣiḥ||||74|| śukraṃ te anyad ityṛcaḥ bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup(chandaḥ) sāmnaḥ pauṣasya pūṣā ṛṣiḥ|| ||75|| iḍāmagre ityṛcaḥ viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ| sāmnaḥ kautsasya kutsa ṛṣiḥ|| ||76|| pra hotā jātaityṛcaḥ vatsapriya ṛṣiḥ | triṣṭup chandaḥ| sāmnoḥ kāśyapayoḥ kaśyapa ṛṣiḥ|| ||77|| pra samrājamasurasya ityṛcaḥ vasiṣṭha ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ| sāmno ghṛtācerāṅgirasasya ghṛtāciraṅgirā ṛṣiḥ||||78|| araṇyornihito jātavedā ityasyā ṛcaḥ viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ|| sāmno bha(|)radvājasya prāsā(hasya)bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ|| ||79|| sanādagre mṛṇasi ityasyā ṛcaḥ pāyurbhāradvāja ṛṣiḥ| triṣṭup chandaḥ| sāmno rakṣoghnasyāgrervaiśvānaro'trirvā ṛṣiḥṣa||||80|| || ityāgneye prathamedhyāye aṣṭamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ|| navamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ|| agra ojiṣṭham ityṛcaḥ ātreyā ṛṣayaḥ | sāmnoḥ pāthayoḥ panthā ṛṣiḥ|| || 81|| yadi vīro anu ṣyād ityṛcaḥ vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ | sāmno bṛhadāgneyasya agniḥ ṛṣiḥ|| ||82|| tveṣaste dhūma ṛṇvati ityasyā ṛcaḥ bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ| sāmno yāmasya yama ṛṣiḥ||83|| tvaṃ hi kṣaitavadityṛcaḥ bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ| sāmno bṛhadāgneyasya agniḥ ṛṣiḥ|| ||84|| prātaragniḥ puru- ityṛcaḥ muktavāhā nvi(dvi?)ta ṛṣiḥ| sāmno bṛhataḥ kaumudasya kumudaḥ ṛṣiḥ||||85|| yadvāhiṣṭhaṃ tadagnayeityṛcaḥ atriputro vasūyava ṛṣiḥ| sāmnorydvāhiṣṭhayoḥ agniḥ ṛṣiḥ || ||86|| viśo viśo vo atithim ityṛcaḥ gopavana ṛṣiḥ| sāmno viśoviśīyasya agnirṛṣiḥ|| ||89|| jātaḥ pareṇa ityṛcaḥ vāmadeva ṛṣiḥ | sāmnaḥ svayoneḥ kaśyapa ṛṣiḥ||||90|| || ityāgneye prathame'dhyāye navamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ|| daśamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ somaṃ rājānamityṛcaḥ agnistāpasa ṛṣiḥ| anuṣṭup chandaḥ| viśvedevā devatā| sāmno
